arrivalEssentials: Make sure your visa or eVisa is approved before departure because a valid visa is generally required to enter India.
Complete the online e-Arrival Card within 72 hours of arrival if it applies to your route and citizenship.
Arrange airport pickup, a taxi app, or enough INR and data for your first transfer out of the airport.
Use sealed bottled water or other trusted drinking water options when you first land.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Your passport should have at least 6 months validity remaining and enough blank pages for entry stamps.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Australian travellers generally need a valid visa or eVisa before arrival unless they hold another status such as OCI; confirm the right category for tourism, business, or conference travel.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: India currently uses an online e-Arrival Card that can be submitted within 72 hours before arrival; depending on the route, you may also be asked for a paper arrival card.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Check the official Indian Visa Online portal and current Australian Smartraveller advice for India shortly before travel.
importantNotes: Use only the official government visa portal and avoid third-party sites that add high service fees.
Processing times and eligible visa categories vary, so do not leave applications to the last minute.

businessEtiquette.summary: Business in India often moves fastest when you pair professionalism with patience, flexibility, and relationship-building.
tips: Build in buffer time because traffic and timing can be less predictable than the calendar suggests.
Start meetings courteously before moving straight into negotiation or hard asks.
Confirm decisions and next steps clearly in writing after meetings.
Expect some agenda movement and stay flexible rather than reacting as if the process is off track.
Relationships matter, so invest a little time in rapport instead of staying purely transactional.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Use bottled, filtered, or otherwise trusted water rather than drinking tap water as a visitor.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is common in hotels and many restaurants, especially when a service charge is not already included.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Vegetarian food is widely available, but spice, dairy, and ghee levels can vary a lot by region and venue.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Choose busy, well-reviewed food spots, and go gently on street food at first if your stomach is not used to it.
usefulPhrases: Card chalta hai? (Do you take card?)

moneyAndPayments.conversion: Check live rates before travel; AUD 1 often lands around INR 54 to 56.
moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards and digital payments are common in hotels, malls, and many urban restaurants, but cash still matters in smaller settings.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Keep small notes for tips, local shops, markets, and backup transport.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Often expected in service settings unless a clear service charge is already included.
roughCostExamples: Beer at a casual venue: about INR 250 to 500 (AUD 5 to 9)
Simple meal: about INR 200 to 500 (AUD 4 to 9)
Airport Metro Express: about INR 60 (around AUD 1)
